$comment: The GITHUB_TOKEN permissions each workflow in .github/workflows/ may request. tests/test_workflow_permissions_policy.py reads every workflow and fails when one asks for a permission not written here, when a workflow is missing from this file, or when an entry here names a workflow or job that no longer exists. Widening what a token can do therefore takes two edits a reviewer sees side by side: the workflow and this file. `workflow` is the top-level permissions block (null means the file declares none, so the repository default applies; "{}" means it grants nothing workflow-wide). `jobs` lists only the jobs that declare their own block; a job not listed here must not declare one. See docs/SECURITY-AI.md.
